frozen_before_scoring_statement: The flavin dehydrogenase/reductase set was selected using only UniProt source metadata and prior-pool exclusions before deterministic sequence-neighbor diagnostics or terminal decisions were computed.

selection_rules: reviewed UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot rows from EC 1.5.1.*, 1.6.5.*, or 1.3.1.* with PDB cross-reference
require catalytic-activity annotation, sequence, active-site or binding-site annotation, and at least one PDB xref
require explicit FAD/FMN/flavin plus dehydrogenase/reductase source context before outcome scoring
exclude imported hard negatives and previously used prospective external candidate accessions
exclude monooxygenase/oxygenase/peroxidase/P450 contexts from this flavin dehydrogenase-reductase lane freeze
cap at two rows per primary EC number
do not use fingerprint scores, sequence-neighbor outcomes, Foldseek, ESM, or ePK evidence for selection
